formal_design_if_eligibility_existed_in_.unit_of_analysis: certified public/development Night-1 personalized subject model
formal_design_if_eligibility_existed_in_.randomness_pairing: Same seed, posterior/nearby draw, initial state, duration, and OU innovations across sham, personalized policy, non-personalized policy, and wrong-subject policy.
formal_design_if_eligibility_existed_in_.policy_selection: On training seeds only, maximize the target-oriented fixed-grid benefit; choose the smallest absolute dose among maxima and then the smaller signed dose. Evaluate once on disjoint evaluation seeds.
formal_design_if_eligibility_existed_in_.matched_nonpersonalized: For each subject, construct an exact leave-one-subject-out componentwise-median parameter model from the other eligible models and apply the same policy-selection rule.
formal_design_if_eligibility_existed_in_.wrong_subject: Sort subject IDs by SHA256(campaign_id+'|'+subject_id), cyclically shift policies by one, and apply the shifted policy to each recipient's own model.
formal_design_if_eligibility_existed_in_.uncertainty: 10000-draw nested paired percentile bootstrap with PCG64(860219), resampling subjects, then within-subject model/posterior draws and paired seeds; simultaneous 95% intervals.
formal_design_if_eligibility_existed_in_.interaction_estimands: I_pop=median_s[G_s(u_s)-G_s(u_pop)]; I_wrong=median_s[G_s(u_s)-G_s(u_wrong(s))]; R_between=median pairwise L2 distance between standardized subject response curves divided by median within-subject bootstrap curve distance.
formal_design_if_eligibility_existed_in_.interaction_threshold: Lower simultaneous 95% bounds for I_pop and I_wrong each exceed 0.25 sham-SD units and lower 95% bound for R_between exceeds 1.5.
formal_design_if_eligibility_existed_in_.multiplicity: Target family and per-target rules in control_target_registry.json apply without modification.

gates.name: Frozen M1-pass candidate
gates.current_reason: Only value-free categorical M1 provenance exists; no exact R4 executable code/configuration/parameter identity is available.
gates.pass_rule: Every identity/hash matches; M1_PASS; verifier VERIFIED; MATERIAL_DISAGREEMENT=false; no outcome-guided candidate switch.
gates.failure_rule: Any mismatch, lower M level, partial verification, disagreement, stale artifact, or missing binding prevents C2.

gates.name: Sham or no-control comparator
gates.pass_rule: Target effect exceeds its registered practical margin and the simultaneous 95% interval excludes the margin under paired sham randomness; at least 30 valid paired blocks per subject-target analysis.
gates.failure_rule: Natural variability explains the effect, pairing is broken, sham differs in anything except intervention, or denominator fails.

gates.name: Matched non-personalized comparator
gates.current_reason: N=0 eligible models; a leave-one-subject-out template cannot be constructed.
gates.pass_rule: I_pop lower simultaneous 95% bound exceeds 0.25 sham-SD units for the target and the matched comparator passes all fairness/hash checks.
gates.failure_rule: Comparator unavailable, not leave-one-subject-out, uses a weaker grid/information budget, or personalized gain does not exceed the practical threshold.

gates.name: Paired randomness
gates.pass_rule: Every sham/intervention/non-personalized/wrong-subject comparison reuses identical seed, model-draw index, initial state, duration, and innovation stream; no unpaired substitution.
gates.failure_rule: Any comparison lacks an exact pair or pairing cannot be independently reproduced.

gates.name: Dose, frequency, phase, or timing response
gates.pass_rule: The complete registered curve or surface is reported; target decision threshold passes on evaluation seeds; selected policy follows the deterministic tie rule; no claim rests on one isolated favorable point.
gates.failure_rule: Missing grid points, post-outcome grid change, single-point success, boundary-only optimum without robustness, or hidden negative doses.

gates.name: Numerical stability
gates.pass_rule: At least 95% of every prescribed target-dose-subject-seed-draw run is stable; all reportable pairs are finite, unclipped, within registered rate bounds, and reproducible.
gates.failure_rule: Divergence, clipping, solver failure, schema failure, nonfinite metrics, saturation, or instability generates or materially changes the effect.

gates.name: Model-level plausibility
gates.pass_rule: Every reportable condition satisfies mean rates 0.5-60 Hz, <=1% samples below 0.01 or above 95 Hz, finite spectra, detector retained-duration >=0.85, and target-specific plausibility rules.
gates.failure_rule: Silent/dead network, saturation, pathological broadband power, invalid detector, regime collapse, or proxy presented as scalp voltage.

gates.name: Off-target analysis
required_inputs: all registered rate and spectral vetoes
gates.pass_rule: All T1-T8 outcomes and hard vetoes are reported for each selected policy; no unacceptable collateral effect; adverse trade-offs are retained and labeled.
gates.failure_rule: Missing off-target cells, target gain driven by broadband/global excitation, any hard veto, or suppression of adverse results.

gates.name: Personalized intervention interaction above uncertainty
gates.current_reason: Zero eligible subjects/models; minimum denominator is 3 and synthetic draws cannot substitute.
gates.pass_rule: I_pop and I_wrong lower simultaneous 95% bounds each exceed 0.25 sham-SD units; R_between lower 95% bound exceeds 1.5; each target's minimum events and multiplicity rule pass.
gates.failure_rule: Only baseline differences are shown, personalization contrasts are within uncertainty, either comparator fails, N<3, or synthetic variants are counted as subjects.

gates.name: Independent reproduction
gates.current_reason: Formal stage is not estimable and no formal result exists to reproduce.
gates.pass_rule: Clean verifier independently reproduces the key response curve, personalization interaction, stability, and off-target matrix; NUMERIC_REPRODUCTION=PASS; PROCEDURAL_FIDELITY=PASS; verifier VERIFIED; MATERIAL_DISAGREEMENT=false; hashes match.
gates.failure_rule: Partial/failed verification, material disagreement, protocol deviation, hash mismatch, or narrative-only review.

universal_assignment_rule.c2_pass: All C2-G1 through C2-G10 PASS, verifier VERIFIED, MATERIAL_DISAGREEMENT=false, and all candidate/protocol/input hashes match.

allowed_wording_if_a_future_exact_candid: Robust subject-dependent bounded in-silico intervention-response profiles were independently reproduced across eligible personalized mechanistic models, with the preregistered interaction exceeding within-model uncertainty and matched non-personalized and wrong-subject responses.
